description: Enrich an agent as its ERC-8004 owner: a card URL, endpoints, skills, a class opt-in. Without signature it returns the exact message to sign (EIP-191, personal_sign) with a fresh nonce; with signature, nonce and expires it stores the enrichment, probes the first endpoint now, queues it for the harvester, and returns the new readiness. Only the on-chain owner’s signature is accepted; a nonce works once.
